title: Blistered cherry tomatoes, mushrooms and eggs on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, garlic, eggs, butter, olive oil, bread and fresh herbs are all plain kitchen foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at Tesco or any mainstream supermarket at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large frying pan with a lid and a toaster or grill, and frying eggs in gaps in the pan is beginner technique.

works.reason: The amounts suit four for breakfast (an egg, a slice of toast and a good spoonful of tomatoes and mushrooms each), the timings are sensible, and making the toast is a detail any cook would fill in.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers slicing the mushrooms and garlic, stripping the thyme, snipping the chives and toasting, and the 13 to 14 minutes of hob time in the steps is close enough to the 12 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Burst cherry tomatoes are the centre of a light July breakfast, which suits midsummer.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, vegetables and wholemeal toast make a proper, filling breakfast that a family would happily cook again.
